summary: list-hygiene-judge is a published Runx graph-runner package for Frantic bounty 68. It reads a contact list-hygiene projection, applies bounded consent-state rules, appends at most one safe transition event for suppress or re-permission lanes, stops on stale or ambiguous evidence, and ships with hosted registry proof, raw PR files, structured verification, and a sealed receipt reference.

observations.finding: The work was validated with runx-cli 0.6.14, satisfying the bounty requirement for runx CLI 0.6.14 or newer.

The package published under rohitmulani63-ops/list-hygiene-judge and registry read resolved version sha-a3364df6aaa1 with digest sha256:24fde586aaff95059c250c77a37aeaf41d0277902a99353d37a76ac8137c691b.
observations.evidence: runx registry publish and runx registry read passed against https://api.runx.ai

observations.finding: The sealed decay lane moves an old but bounce-free contact to re_permission and appends exactly one list_hygiene.transitioned event.
observations.evidence: harness case sealed_decay_re_permission passed with decision_state re_permission and append_event_count 1

observations.finding: The hard-bounce lane suppresses the contact and appends exactly one list_hygiene.transitioned event when no active unsubscribe blocker is present.
observations.evidence: harness case sealed_hard_bounce_suppress passed with decision_state suppress and append_event_count 1

observations.finding: Missing, stale, or ambiguous consent evidence routes to human_review and appends no transition event, preventing unsafe list mutation.
observations.evidence: harness case stop_missing_or_stale_evidence passed with decision_state human_review and append_event_count 0

observations.finding: When the decision answer is not supplied by the host, the graph pauses as needs_agent instead of inventing a consent-state transition.
observations.evidence: harness case needs_agent_missing_decision_answer passed with expected_status needs_agent

observations.finding: The package vendors data.local and data.sqlite tool manifests/runtimes so hosted validation can run from uploaded package material without relying on a system SQLite binary.
observations.evidence: skills/list-hygiene-judge/tools/data/local and skills/list-hygiene-judge/tools/data/sqlite are included in the PR head commit

observations.finding: The skill is dispatch-free: it does not send outbound messages, does not mint grants, does not touch payout rails, and only produces bounded consent-state decisions/events.
observations.evidence: SKILL.md behavior and harness cases cover only read, decide, append, stop paths

dogfood.environment: Docker Desktop Linux hosted-like mode with RUNX_TOOL_ROOTS pointing at packaged tools, RUNX_REGISTRY_DIR unset, and RUNX_DATA_SOURCES unset
dogfood.proves: consent-state decision for a stale contact, data-store read from the packaged local fixture adapter, and exactly one safe list_hygiene.transitioned append event
